Cut 6 of the `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). The claim is `6414562831`. Four bodies of the "Hook dispatch internals" section move unedited into a new module, `packages/objectql/src/engine-hook-dispatch.ts`: `buildPerRowAfterContexts`, `dispatchPerRowBeforeHooks`, `assertBulkPerRowHookBudget` and `inAfterAbortUnit`. No hook behaviour changes. #25522 stays open for the later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-2f5vpq` (the card thread's harness-pinned branch), cut from `origin/main` at `712770bee` (after cut 5, `4bea75589f`), with `main` merged in twice (`be7897799`, then `aa2f8e31f`, because `dispatch-gates` reported a stale gate script). Neither merge touched `engine.ts`.

The per-method move screen for every section is in the project file `pm-orders/server/25522-cut6-seam-table.md`. A body stays if any of these holds: an inferred-return public method, a U site, a private-static read, an `engine.ts#NAME` pointer under `packages/spec/**` or `docs/adr/**`, or a `this.update(` / `this.insert(` / `this.delete(` self-call. The pick:

| area | 30-day lines | movable | why not / why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Roll-up summaries | 0 of 451 | 46 body lines | `buildSummaryIndex` is cited from `packages/spec` (`functional-completeness.ts`); `recomputeSummaries` self-calls `this.update(`; `ensureSummaryIndexes` writes three fields. Does not pay |
| Datasource registry | 1 of 209 | 27 body lines | `unregisterDriver` and `clearDatasourceUnavailable` are U sites (U = 3); `registerDatasourceDef` is cited from `liveness/datasource.json`. Does not pay |
| Related-record expansion | 10 of 254 | 0 | `expandRelatedRecords` reads the private static `MAX_EXPAND_DEPTH` and is cited from `liveness/query.json` and `liveness/field.json` |
| Migration flags and attestations | 81 of 683 | 176 body lines | `recordObservedDeviation` and `retractCreationAttestation` self-call `this.update(`; the rest write five fields, so the host needs setters, a shape no cut has used |
| Driver options, File-reference hydration, Referential integrity, Readable-ids | 209 to 546 recent | 161 to 438 | the hottest sections; the card says take the coldest |
| **Hook dispatch internals** (this PR) | **53 of 477** | **4 of 7 bodies, 141 body lines** | the coldest section with more than 100 movable lines; reads one field and no setter; no `packages/spec` or `docs/adr` pointer |

Three bodies of the section stay in the class: `hasHooksFor`, `opensAfterAbortUnit` and `dispatchUnscopedMultiWriteHooks`. Each calls `hookMatchesObject`, a function `engine.ts` declares and exports at module level. Reaching it from the new module would be a value import of `engine.ts`, which would be the series' first run-time module cycle (every `engine-*.ts` module imports the engine as a type only).

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1 to 5 apply it)

- The class keeps all four methods with name, modifiers, signature, docblock and position. Each body is now one host literal plus `fn.call(host, …)`, marked `[#25522 cut 6]`.
- `HookDispatchHost` is new: `_registry`, `triggerHooks`, `transaction`, each typed as the class member (`ObjectQL['triggerHooks']`). Each moved function types its `this` as the `Pick` of exactly the members its body reads, and each stub annotates its literal as `ThisParameterType` of that function. There is no cast, and no member changes visibility.
- `_registry` goes as a GETTER. `triggerHooks` and `transaction` go as late-bound closures over the instance, so a double or spy set on the engine still intercepts.
- `inAfterAbortUnit` is generic, so its stub instantiates the function with the method's own type parameter `T` before `.call(host, write)`. A bare `.call` would erase `T` to `unknown`. The emitted JS is a plain `.call`.
- `assertBulkPerRowHookBudget` reads no member and is called directly.
- **Imports.** The module imports `ObjectQL` as a TYPE only and nothing re-exports it. `engine.ts` drops the names whose last code reader moved: `resolveBulkPerRowHookBudget`, `divergingHookPayloadKeys` and `MultiUpdateHookKeyDivergenceError`. The last one is still named by a `{@link}` in the `dispatchPerRowBeforeHooks` docblock that stays, and that docblock goes to no published `.d.ts`, because private members print without JSDoc. `SummaryRecomputeError`, `HookTargetRebindError`, `coerceBooleanFields`, `recordHookPayloadWrites` and `MAX_BULK_PER_ROW_HOOK_ROWS` still have readers in `engine.ts` and stay.

## Net lines (the seat's rule)

`engine.ts` goes from 23,351 to 23,234 lines, **net -117**. The module is 240 lines: the header and host interface (about 66), four one-line docblocks, and the 141 moved body lines with their signatures. The diff is 415 changed lines over 2 files (+269 / -146), far under the 3,000-line human-merge threshold.

The same six-file comparison at `712770bee` was also byte-identical.

## Proof of move-only

A TypeScript-AST leaf-token compare (recursive `getChildren`, JSDoc skipped) of base `engine.ts` against the head module:

- For each of the four, the parameters (less `this`), return type, type parameters and body tokens are **SAME**, `async` matches, and every body line equals the base line less two leading spaces, comments included: `dispatchPerRowBeforeHooks` 454 tokens / 103 lines, `buildPerRowAfterContexts` 165 / 17, `inAfterAbortUnit` 73 / 12 (type parameter `T` on both), `assertBulkPerRowHookBudget` 73 / 9.
- **Negative controls:** flipping `===` to `!==` in the moved `assertBulkPerRowHookBudget` reports DIFFER. Editing only the `// D4.` comment in the moved `dispatchPerRowBeforeHooks` fails the line rule. Both exit 1.
- Class: 318 members at both ends, in the same order. 314 are byte-identical (full text, docblocks included), and the 4 stubs keep docblock, modifiers and signature byte-identical up to the body.
- Top level: 226 of 229 base statements are byte-identical in head. The other three are the class, the narrowed `@objectstack/spec/data` import and the removed `multi-update-hook-key-divergence.js` import. Head adds the new module import with its comment.

## Readers of the moved lines

- No path reader names the four. No `engine.ts#NAME` pointer anywhere in the repository names one. No `scripts/adr-anchors/**` paragraph describes them: the engine entry's paragraph is the transaction seam. No gate or source-reading test matches their text (screened: every `scripts/` gate, `docs/qa`, `content/docs`, and the 14 test files that read `engine.ts` from disk).
- `packages/spec/liveness`: 40 entries cite `engine.ts`, and every one of their keys is still mentioned in `engine.ts` outside the moved range, so the key-mention check loses nothing.
- **ADR anchors.** The moved bodies carry no `ADR-NNNN` citation (the `ADR-0058` and `ADR-0119 D1` citations sit in the docblocks, which stay). `check-adr-anchors` counts the same at base and head: 88 anchored files and 1,864 decision-letter citations at `712770bee`, and 88 and 1,878 at `be7897799` against head `1b00a88a9`. No anchor entry is needed.
- **Census and receivers.** `check-tenant-audit-census` is green: 243 write call sites, and the moved bodies hold no `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` site. `check:logger-receiver-detach` is green (the moved bodies read no logger), and so is `check-system-context-census`.

## Acceptance notes

- Prose that names `engine.ts` beside a moved method still resolves by method name, because every method stays on the class. Examples are `service-storage`'s `attachment-lifecycle.ts` and `plugin-audit`'s `audit-writers.ts` comments, and `spec`'s `bulk-write-hook-conformance.ts` naming `ObjectQL.assertBulkPerRowHookBudget`. They are left as they are.
- The moved `dispatchPerRowBeforeHooks` body still says "see the class doc above" next to the D3 accumulate step. The doc it means is the method's docblock in `engine.ts`. The comment is unedited because this is a move.
- Serial check, re-read before `pr_create`: 38 PRs are open. One touches `engine.ts`: #26026 (seat 1's #24768, `claude/project-thread-otcr21` at `50c3929ba`), with hunks at lines 209, 8621-8674, 17122, 17310 and 18743-19275. This PR's range is 5343-5819. `git merge-tree --write-tree` of the two heads is clean (exit 0). Whichever lands second merges `main`.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` + `check:test-typecheck`, 39 files / 233 errors / 64 pinned signatures held): exit 0. `eslint --no-inline-config packages/objectql`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`: 470 files, 8,748 tests, 8,748 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. The same suite was also green before the first merge (`50dae828a`: 470 files, 8,742 tests). The run includes `bulk-write-per-row-hooks.test.ts`, `multi-update-hook-key-divergence.test.ts`, `engine-after-hook-abort-unit.test.ts` and `hook-exclude-objects.test.ts`.
- `packages/core` `row-serving-door-exposure.pin.test.ts` and `second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts` (both scan the repository for read doors): 2 files, 7 tests passed.
- Dependants: every changed member keeps its declaration and all six published `.d.ts` files are byte-identical, so no dependant can see a difference. CI's `TypeScript Type Check` covers them.
- Gates at the final head `69d8f91a6`: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 56 families on the real diff. Every one was run, each exit code captured before any pipe, then reconciled with `--ran`: 56 accounted for, 55 run, 1 NOT MEASURED. **NOT MEASURED** (CI runs it): `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET. It needs every package's `dist/`; the export lists above answer it for objectql. Named readings: `check-system-context-census` OK (151 read sites, 144 of 144 symbols cited), `check:logger-receiver-detach` OK, `check:durability-log-level` OK, `check-engine-split-ratio --days 90` 97.6%.
- Hand gates outside the derivation, all exit 0 at `69d8f91a6`: `check-adr-anchors` at base `aa2f8e31f` and at head (88 files and 1,878 letters at both ends), `check-adr-symbol-anchors` (2,658 anchors resolve), `check-tenant-audit-census` (243 write call sites), `check-nul-bytes`, `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` (13 anchors judged, 0 lost) and `check-commit-card-trailers --range origin/main..HEAD`.
- No ablation, because no tested behaviour changed. `test:repo` was not run locally; CI's `Test Core` runs it.

`skip-changeset`: move-only. The published `.d.ts` files and export lists are byte-identical, `liveness/` and every other published path are untouched, and the module's runtime is the same code under a different file name.
